title: Make acceptance-request Candidate recovery refusals actionable without weakening authority fences
outcome: Request-side Candidate recovery refusals explain their cause and available retry/remedy, preserve durability-boundary reporting, and safely handle already-confirmed concurrent publication only through existing exact-owner/image checks.
acceptance: Refused request-side Candidate recovery gives cause-and-remedy wording and preserves existing pending-durability/refusal semantics without admitting unconfirmed, superseded or expired authority; any same-owner concurrent-publication handling preserves the existing exact-image/current-authority checks.
